item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03050","case1_error":"Evaluates the correctly written calorie sum as 2175 instead of 1975.","case2_error":"Answer markers say 14, contradicting the correct derivation of 2 slices; no mathematical error appears in the derivation.","reason":"Case 1 has an arithmetic evaluation error; case 2 has only an answer conflict.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J03051","case1_error":"Uses purchase cost per egg instead of selling price to calculate how many sales recover the investment.","case2_error":"Invents four additional working hours, then treats truck capacity as an hourly rate to calculate elapsed time.","reason":"Using the wrong monetary rate differs from inventing a duration and converting capacity into a work rate.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03052","case1_error":"Counts the two parent lambs again even though they are already included in the original six.","case2_error":"Omits the first turn's eight spaces when calculating Susan's current position.","reason":"Case 1 double-counts an included quantity; case 2 drops a required contribution.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03053","case1_error":"Substitutes one Monday count for Tuesday's two tile counts, producing an incorrect Tuesday total.","case2_error":"Evaluates 20 − (2 + 4 + 1 + 4) as 11 instead of 9.","reason":"Case 1 selects incorrect contributions to the requested total; case 2 numerically miscalculates its correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03054","case1_error":"Uses two houses for the combined total, omitting Zion's house from the three participants.","case2_error":"Gives an unsupported final 6000 after correctly stating initial population plus ten times that population, which yields 5500.","reason":"Case 1 uses an incorrect total-area relation; case 2 supplies an incorrect final number without showing a numerical evaluation.","judgment":"different"}]}
